description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Motorola Solutions is a global community dedicated to enhancing safety through innovative technologies. The Embedded Software Engineer will develop solutions for real-world systems and collaborate with product development teams to create high-quality embedded software products.
Embedded systems developer for hardware products, requirements-to-validation development and hardware debugging

Responsibilities:
• Develop solutions for real world systems and standalone products to enhance existing Applied Technology offerings
• Collaborate with multi-disciplinary product development teams
• Perform duties in all areas of development (i.e. requirements analysis, high and low-level design, coding, model training and evaluation, documentation, real world testing, and validation)
• Hands-on interaction with product hardware for developing and debugging

Requirements:
• Bachelor's (BS) or Master's (MS) degree
• Experience programming in C, C++, and/or Python
• Must be a U.S. citizen with ability to obtain necessary security clearance as required by government contract

Preferred:
• Assembly Language Experience
• Practical experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and debugging microcontroller software
• Agile software development and/or Git/JIRA experience
• Willingness to learn one or more wireless communication standards (GSM, CDMA, UMTS, LTE, Tetra, etc.)
